Our launch vehicle, Big Iron, is a stainless-steel rocket with a reusable booster powered by nine Clydesdale liquid oxygen and methane engines, and an upper stage that stays in orbit as a data-center satellite. The role Be the engineer our teams turn to when a design question needs fluids-flow physics to settle it. You will work across the launch vehicle, its engines, our satellites, and our test facilities: steady and unsteady external aerodynamics, aerothermal and plume environments, and internal and thermal-fluid flows, across the full mission from launch through ascent, descent, and landing. Design engineers own the hardware, and the thermal, structures, loads, guidance and flight dynamics, and fluids analysts own their models. jobs.description_text: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. As an Infrastructure Engineer on Infra Labs, you will own the racks and server infrastructure across Etched's labs and data center sites, from our office lab at Santana Row to our new hardware facility in Milpitas and our Bay Area colocation footprint. Once our forward-deployed engineers physically install a system, you take it from there: getting it onto the network, provisioned, connected to the storage and compute services it depends on, observable, and healthy through bring-up and testing. You'll support our current rack-scale systems, stand up labs for our next-generation racks and next-generation silicon, and help build the internal deployments that let us run our systems the way our customers do.
